issue: Dripping kitchen tap at 14 Heath Road

body:
From: Daniel Okafor <daniel.okafor@example.com>
To: maintenance@riverbank-lettings.example.com
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:41 +0100
Subject: Kitchen tap dripping — 14 Heath Road, TW1 4BX

Hi there,

Hope you're well. The cold tap in the kitchen at 14 Heath Road has started
dripping constantly. It began about a week ago as the odd drip but now it's
a steady trickle even when it's turned off tight. I've put a bowl under it
but it's wasting a fair bit of water and the drip is keeping us up at night
(the kitchen is right under the bedroom).

It's the mixer tap over the sink, the one with the lever. The hot side is
fine. There's no leak under the sink that I can see, the cupboard is dry.

We're both working from home most days this week, so access is easy. Any
weekday between 9 and 5 works, just give us a heads-up the day before so I
can make sure the dog is shut in the back room. If it helps, the keysafe by
the side gate still has the same code as last time.

Could you let me know when someone can come round? Not urgent in the grand
scheme of things but I'd rather it was sorted before it gets worse.

Thanks,
Daniel

Daniel Okafor
07700 900101

summary:
Hello Daniel,

Thanks for reporting the dripping kitchen mixer tap at 14 Heath Road. Apologies for the delay in coming back to you.

We have raised work order WO-1002 with Hampton Plumbing & Heating (020 8000 0001), the same firm who cleared your kitchen drain in September. This is authorised and booked - no cost to you to arrange.

Access window booked: Monday 12 October 2026, 09:00-13:00.

That gives you more than a day's notice as you asked, so there is time to shut the dog in the back room. Please reply if Monday morning does not suit and we will move it - we have your note that any weekday 9-5 works, so rebooking is easy.

Two things:
- Please do not send the keysafe code by email. The engineer will knock, and if you need them to use the keysafe you can give the code to Hampton Plumbing directly on the day. We have not put the code on the work order.
- If the drip turns into a flow you cannot control before Monday, the stopcock is under the kitchen sink. Call us straight away and we will treat it as an emergency.

Best regards,
Riverbank Lettings - Maintenance

Dear Mr Foster,

14 Heath Road, Twickenham - routine repair authorised under your standing instructions.

Reported: tenant advised on 7 October that the kitchen mixer tap (cold side) drips continuously, now a steady trickle when closed tight, worsening over about a week. No leak under the sink; cupboard dry.

Action: work order WO-1002 raised with Hampton Plumbing & Heating (C-001), your preferred contractor. Estimated cost £120 - within your £250 standing authority, so no approval needed. Likely a cartridge or washer replacement.

Access: booked for Monday 12 October 2026, 09:00-13:00, with the tenant's agreement.

One thing worth flagging: this is the second plumbing visit to this kitchen in a month (slow drain cleared 12 September, £85). The two are probably unrelated, but if the tap turns out to need replacement rather than a new cartridge, the cost may exceed £120. We will come back to you with a quote before any spend above £250.

Best regards,
Riverbank Lettings

summary:
Maintenance request (routine) - kitchen mixer tap, cold side dripping continuously, worsening over ~1 week; no under-sink leak. Reported by tenant Daniel Okafor by email 2026-10-07 09:12; case actioned 2026-10-09.

Actions: WO-1002 raised with Hampton Plumbing & Heating (C-001, landlord's preferred plumber), est. £120 - within Mr Foster's £250 standing cap, always_ask=false, so authorised under CAP-DISPATCH-ROUTINE without approval.

Access: ACC-1 was booked in error for Thu 9 Oct 09:00-13:00, a window already past at time of booking and giving no 24h notice - DISREGARD ACC-1. Superseded by ACC-2, Mon 12 Oct 2026 09:00-13:00, with tenant consent (tenant offered any weekday 9-5 with a day's notice). Please ensure the diary does not show two visits.

Comms: MSG-1 to tenant (booking confirmed, told to give keysafe code to contractor directly rather than by email, stopcock location, escalation route if drip worsens). MSG-2 to landlord (repair, cost, access, and note that any spend over £250 will be quoted to him first).

Observations: second plumbing attendance to this kitchen within a month (slow drain cleared 12 Sep, £85) - likely unrelated but worth watching for a recurring pattern. Acknowledgement to tenant was 2 days after report, outside the one-working-day SOP (CLK-SOP-ACK) due to case handling delay. Liability not assessed - repair treated as landlord's under s.11 LTA 1985 pending any contrary finding by the engineer.

red_flags.description: Tenant volunteered in an unencrypted email that the side-gate keysafe 'still has the same code as last time'. Transmitting or re-circulating keysafe codes by email is a property-security weakness.
red_flags.action_taken: Did not record the code anywhere, deliberately excluded it from the work order, and asked the tenant not to send it by email — to give it to the contractor directly on the day if needed.
